title: Passthrough

force_fail.description: Only the exact strings 1 and true enable failure before reading or writing; every other string disables it.

delay_ms.description: Delay after copying, in milliseconds. Parse as a base-10 integer and clamp to 0..60000; an empty or invalid integer string retains the instance's current delay.

limitations: Declared field semantics do not prove row data quality.
Only the first input contributes to the output; additional inputs retain the historical ignored-input behavior.
